text.title: Conversion Tracking Output Contract
text.summary: JSON Schema (draft-07) for the conversion-tracking config: the site domain and destinations, the `events.yml` registry enforced by `validate-events.py` in CI, Consent Mode v2 defaults pushed before the config call with regional defaults and mirrored server-side, the first-party server endpoint that forwards the browser identifiers and never mints its own, an event taxonomy inside the GA4 limits where every monetary event carries value, currency and a per-order transaction_id shared as the event id across destinations, and a QA record with one fixture per event run in Chrome, Safari, Firefox and an ad-blocker profile, whose example payloads carry no PII. Validator at scripts/validate-conversion-tracking.py enforces it, including the endpoint host, the dual-send dedup and the fixture coverage.

required.field: the registrable site domain and at least one of ga4, google_ads, meta, plausible
`mode: v2`, `defaults_before_config: true`, the four `signals`, `regional_defaults[]` with `region`, `server_honours_consent: true` (r-consent-state-before-any-tag)

`enabled`; when enabled, `endpoint` on a first-party subdomain of `site_domain`, `cookies_http_only: true`, `forwards` including `_fbp`, `_fbc`, `client_id`, `session_id`, `client_id_source: _ga cookie`, `fresh_ids_generated: false` (r-server-endpoint-first-party-domain, r-browser-server-dedup-and-identifiers)

each with snake_case `name` (at most 40 characters, no reserved prefix), `recommended`, at most 25 `parameters` (names at most 40, string values at most 100, `pii: false`, `hashed` for matching identifiers), `conversion_role` per destination, `monetary`, `sent_from`, and `dedup` (`event_id_field`, `shared_across_destinations: true`) whenever monetary or sent from both browser and server (r-ga4-naming-and-parameter-limits, r-monetary-conversion-carries-transaction-id, r-browser-server-dedup-and-identifiers, r-event-registry-single-source)

`change_ref`, `browsers` Chrome / Safari / Firefox, `adblock_profile: true`, `fixtures[]` one per event with `expected_parameters`, a PII-free `example_payload` and `results[]` per browser and destination (r-qa-fixtures-per-tracking-change, r-no-pii-in-parameters)

forbidden.pattern: a monetary event without `value`, `currency` and `transaction_id` parameters, or whose `dedup.event_id_field` is not `transaction_id` — double-counted-conversions

an event name not in snake_case, over 40 characters, with a reserved prefix, or a synonym of a recommended event (`order_completed`, `signup`, `lead`) — event-name-drift, r-ga4-naming-and-parameter-limits
`consent.defaults_before_config: false`, a missing v2 signal, or `server_honours_consent: false` — tags-fire-before-consent
`server_side.fresh_ids_generated: true`, or `client_id_source` other than the `_ga` cookie, or `_fbp` / `_fbc` not forwarded with Meta as a destination — fresh-client-id-server-side
a parameter with `pii: true`, an unhashed matching identifier, or an example payload containing an `@` or a phone-shaped string — pii-in-event-payload
fixtures run in fewer than three browsers or without the ad-blocker profile, or an event with no fixture — qa-only-in-chrome
`server_side.endpoint` not a subdomain of `site_domain`, or `cookies_http_only: false` — r-server-endpoint-first-party-domain
an event sent from both browser and server without `dedup`, or `registry.enforced_in_ci: false` — r-browser-server-dedup-and-identifiers, r-event-registry-single-source

list.item: Every event name is in `events.yml` with its conversion role per destination, and `validate-events.py` runs in CI (r-event-registry-single-source).

Names are snake_case, at most 40 characters, with no reserved prefix; at most 25 parameters, strings at most 100 characters; recommended events use the exact recommended name (r-ga4-naming-and-parameter-limits).
Every monetary event carries `value`, `currency` and `transaction_id`, and `transaction_id` is the shared event id across destinations (r-monetary-conversion-carries-transaction-id).
Every event sent from browser and server has a `dedup` block, and the server forwards `_fbp`, `_fbc`, the `_ga` client_id and session_id without minting ids (r-browser-server-dedup-and-identifiers).
Consent Mode v2 defaults with all four signals precede the config call, regional defaults are set, and the server honours the same signals (r-consent-state-before-any-tag).
No parameter is PII, matching identifiers are hashed, and no example payload contains an `@` or a phone-shaped string (r-no-pii-in-parameters).
The server endpoint is a subdomain of `site_domain` with HttpOnly cookies (r-server-endpoint-first-party-domain).
Every event has a fixture with results for Chrome, Safari, Firefox and the ad-blocker profile across every destination it targets (r-qa-fixtures-per-tracking-change).

text.reference: Validator implementing this schema and the endpoint, dedup, PII and fixture-coverage checks.
